view.wireNotesHint: Gauge, colour and cut length printed along every wire. Always exported to SVG/PDF; this toggle only hides it on screen.
view.shapesHint: Rectangles, lines, circles and polylines drawn as pure graphics. They carry no electrical meaning.

annotationText.hint: The size of the wire notes, wire numbers and net tags. It is a drawing standard, so it is set per sheet. Leave it empty for the default (2.0mm).
annotationText.range: {min}-{max}mm. On a drawing where devices sit on a 5mm pitch, about 1.4mm keeps a note off the row below.

netLabel.tagHint: Draws the net label as a directional flag, so the reader sees at a glance which way the signal goes.
netLabel.tagChangedLog: Net label {name}: tag shape set to {tag}

note.anchorHint: Which part of the text sits on the note's coordinate. Use "Right" for notes against devices on the right-hand side so their right edges line up whatever the text length.
note.colorHint: Pick the note colour from a fixed set of names. Screen and paper each get a colour that reads well there, so raw colour codes are not accepted.
note.functionHint: What this device does, printed under the symbol (the third text field after the designator and the type number).

relay.deviceBlockHint: Draws this coil as one outline with the designator, part number and a contact image (pin numbers and drawing address for every contact sharing this designator), instead of the small coil symbol and a separate contact map. The contacts stay individually placed and wired; only the coil's own drawing changes.

mate.hint: The reference designator of the mating connector (plug↔socket). Declaring it on both connectors links the pair; the wire list and from-to report carry a mate column, and a short dashed line is drawn automatically when both are on the same sheet within 50mm.

projectInfo.title: Project information
projectInfo.note: Name and number are set on the project. Company, drawing number and title are written to every sheet's title block at once.
projectInfo.name: Project name
projectInfo.hint: Saving runs one command (undoable). Only the fields you changed are written; the title block fields overwrite every sheet. The company, drawing number and title shown here are read from the sheet you are on, and saving applies them to all of them.

sheetPaper.title: Change paper — {sheet}
sheetPaper.note: Existing entities keep their coordinates; nothing is moved or deleted. Anything left outside the new paper is reported as an ERC warning instead.
sheetPaper.savedLog: Paper size: saved for "{sheet}" (undo with Cmd+Z)
sheetPaper.noSheetLog: Paper size: no sheet is open

panel.empty: Every part on the schematic is already on a panel.
panel.hint: Click a part, then click on the panel sheet to place it. It snaps onto a DIN rail; R turns it.
panel.errorHint: The list of unplaced parts could not be read: {error}

statusHint.sized: The outline comes from the parts database.
statusHint.default: The part number has no outline in the parts database, so the default rectangle is used.
statusHint.unregistered: This part has no part number yet, so the default rectangle is used.

panel.todoPhase: Planned for a later phase of the panel layout work

sheets.addHint: Pick what the new sheet is for.

wireParts.autoHint: The part number looked up from the wire-part table by colour and gauge. A wire with an empty part number is listed with this one.
wireParts.manualHint: A part number written here wins over the wire-part table. Leave it empty to take the number from the table.

shapes.ribbonHint: Draw an enclosure, a highlight box or a note frame. Graphics carry no electrical meaning, so they never reach the netlist, the checks or any report.

startLog.rect: Rectangle: drag to draw (Esc to cancel)
startLog.line: Line: drag from one end to the other (Esc to cancel)
startLog.circle: Circle: drag from the centre outwards (Esc to cancel)
startLog.polyline: Polyline: click each corner, double-click or Enter to finish (Esc to cancel)

added.rect: Graphics: added a rectangle (undo with Cmd+Z)
added.line: Graphics: added a line (undo with Cmd+Z)
added.circle: Graphics: added a circle (undo with Cmd+Z)
added.polyline: Graphics: added a polyline (undo with Cmd+Z)

shapes.polylineHint: Click each corner in turn, then double-click or press Enter to finish.
shapes.strokeHint: Pick the colour from a fixed set of names, the same ones the notes use. Screen and paper each get a colour that reads well there, so raw colour codes are not accepted.
shapes.fillHint: Shades the inside of the shape. The fill is kept light so the wires and symbols underneath stay readable.

prop.hint: A shape is drawing only: it never appears in the netlist, the checks, the parts list or the wire list. Draw enclosures with a shape and keep harness boundaries for grouping wires.
